#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# artifact-cleanup.sh — apply CI artifact retention policies and produce a
# deletion plan.
#
# Reads a CSV inventory of artifacts (name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,
# run_id), applies up to three retention policies, and reports which
# artifacts would be (or were) deleted:
#
#   --max-age-days N     delete artifacts older than N days
#   --max-total-bytes N  delete oldest-first until total retained size <= N
#   --keep-latest N      per workflow, always protect the N most recent
#                         artifacts; anything beyond that cutoff is deleted
#                         for exceeding the keep-latest cap
#
# keep-latest-protected artifacts are exempt from every other policy. Any
# policy left at 0 is disabled.
#
# Defaults to --dry-run (report only). --execute additionally rewrites the
# input file (or --state-file, if given) to drop deleted rows, simulating a
# real deletion against the artifact store.
set -euo pipefail

readonly PROG="${0##*/}"

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ${PROG} --input FILE --now ISO8601 [options]

Required:
  --input FILE            CSV inventory: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  --now ISO8601           Reference timestamp used for age calculations

Options:
  --max-age-days N        Delete artifacts older than N days (default: disabled)
  --max-total-bytes N     Cap total retained size in bytes (default: disabled)
  --keep-latest N         Always protect the N most recent artifacts per workflow (default: disabled)
  --execute                Actually apply the plan (rewrites --state-file / --input)
  --dry-run                Report only; do not mutate any file (default)
  --state-file FILE        File to rewrite on --execute (default: --input)
  -h, --help                Show this help
EOF
}

die() {
  echo "${PROG}: error: $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

require_number() {
  # require_number LABEL VALUE — die unless VALUE is a non-negative integer.
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "$1 must be a non-negative integer, got: '$2'"
}

to_epoch() {
  # to_epoch ISO8601 — echo Unix seconds, or die with a clear message.
  local epoch
  if ! epoch="$(date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)"; then
    die "invalid date/timestamp: '$1'"
  fi
  echo "$epoch"
}

# Parallel arrays describing every artifact read from the input file, plus
# per-artifact working state computed by the policy passes below.
declare -a AC_NAME AC_SIZE AC_CREATED AC_WORKFLOW AC_RUNID AC_EPOCH
declare -a AC_PROTECTED AC_DELETED AC_REASON

read_artifacts() {
  # read_artifacts FILE — populate the AC_* arrays from a CSV inventory.
  # Format: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  # A header row (first non-comment line) is skipped if present. Blank lines
  # and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
  local file="$1" line lineno=0 header_skipped=0
  local name size created workflow runid

  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    if [ "$header_skipped" -eq 0 ] && [[ "$line" == name,size_bytes,* ]]; then
      header_skipped=1
      continue
    fi
    header_skipped=1

    IFS=',' read -r name size created workflow runid <<<"$line"
    if [ -z "$name" ] || [ -z "$size" ] || [ -z "$created" ] || [ -z "$workflow" ] || [ -z "$runid" ]; then
      die "${file}:${lineno}: expected 5 comma-separated fields, got: '${line}'"
    fi
    [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "${file}:${lineno}: size_bytes must be a non-negative integer, got: '${size}'"

    AC_NAME+=("$name")
    AC_SIZE+=("$size")
    AC_CREATED+=("$created")
    AC_WORKFLOW+=("$workflow")
    AC_RUNID+=("$runid")
    AC_EPOCH+=("$(to_epoch "$created")")
    AC_PROTECTED+=(0)
    AC_DELETED+=(0)
    AC_REASON+=("retained")
  done <"$file"
}

apply_keep_latest() {
  # apply_keep_latest N — for each workflow, protect the N most recent
  # artifacts from every other policy; mark anything beyond that cutoff for
  # deletion (reason=exceeds-keep-latest). No-op when N==0 (disabled).
  local keep="$1"
  [ "$keep" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local workflows
  workflows="$(printf '%s\n' "${AC_WORKFLOW[@]}" | sort -u)"

  local wf
  while IFS= read -r wf; do
    [ -z "$wf" ] && continue
    # index:epoch pairs for this workflow, newest first.
    local i ranked rank=0 idx
    ranked=""
    for i in "${!AC_WORKFLOW[@]}"; do
      [ "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" = "$wf" ] && ranked+="${AC_EPOCH[$i]} ${i}"$'\n'
    done
    while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
      [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
      rank=$((rank + 1))
      if [ "$rank" -le "$keep" ]; then
        AC_PROTECTED[idx]=1
      else
        AC_DELETED[idx]=1
        AC_REASON[idx]="exceeds-keep-latest"
      fi
    done < <(printf '%s' "$ranked" | sort -rn -k1,1)
  done <<<"$workflows"
}

apply_max_age() {
  # apply_max_age DAYS NOW_EPOCH — mark unprotected, not-yet-deleted
  # artifacts older than DAYS as deleted (reason=age). No-op when DAYS==0.
  local max_age_days="$1" now_epoch="$2"
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i age_days
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    age_days=$(( (now_epoch - AC_EPOCH[i]) / 86400 ))
    if [ "$age_days" -gt "$max_age_days" ]; then
      AC_DELETED[i]=1
      AC_REASON[i]="age"
    fi
  done
}

apply_max_total_bytes() {
  # apply_max_total_bytes MAX — delete oldest-first among unprotected,
  # not-yet-deleted artifacts until the retained total fits under MAX.
  # No-op when MAX==0 (disabled).
  local max_total_bytes="$1"
  [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i total=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    total=$((total + AC_SIZE[i]))
  done
  [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && return 0

  local candidates i2 idx
  candidates=""
  for i2 in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    candidates+="${AC_EPOCH[$i2]} ${i2}"$'\n'
  done

  while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
    [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
    [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && break
    AC_DELETED[idx]=1
    AC_REASON[idx]="max-total-size"
    total=$((total - AC_SIZE[idx]))
  done < <(printf '%s' "$candidates" | sort -n -k1,1)
}

print_plan_and_summary() {
  # print_plan_and_summary INPUT_BASENAME DRY_RUN — emit the human-readable
  # plan plus a single machine-parseable RESULT line.
  local input_base="$1" dry_run="$2"
  local mode_label="DRY RUN"
  [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && mode_label="EXECUTE"

  echo "Artifact Cleanup Plan (${mode_label}) for ${input_base}"
  echo ""

  local i verb reclaimed=0 retained_bytes=0 deleted_count=0 retained_count=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    if [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ]; then
      verb="DELETE"
      [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && verb="DELETED"
      reclaimed=$((reclaimed + AC_SIZE[i]))
      deleted_count=$((deleted_count + 1))
    else
      verb="RETAIN"
      retained_bytes=$((retained_bytes + AC_SIZE[i]))
      retained_count=$((retained_count + 1))
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\tworkflow=%s\tsize_bytes=%s\tcreated=%s\treason=%s\n' \
      "$verb" "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_REASON[$i]}"
  done

  echo ""
  echo "Summary:"
  echo "  Total artifacts: ${#AC_NAME[@]}"
  echo "  Retained:        ${retained_count} (${retained_bytes} bytes)"
  echo "  Deleted:         ${deleted_count} (${reclaimed} bytes)"
  echo "  Space reclaimed: ${reclaimed} bytes"
  echo ""
  echo "RESULT input=${input_base} total=${#AC_NAME[@]} retained=${retained_count} deleted=${deleted_count} reclaimed_bytes=${reclaimed} retained_bytes=${retained_bytes}"
}

rewrite_state_file() {
  # rewrite_state_file FILE — drop deleted rows from FILE, keeping the
  # header and any retained rows, in their original order. Used by
  # --execute to simulate the artifact actually being removed from storage.
  local file="$1" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  echo "name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id" >"$tmp"
  local i
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    printf '%s,%s,%s,%s,%s\n' "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_RUNID[$i]}" >>"$tmp"
  done
  mv "$tmp" "$file"
}

main() {
  local input="" now="" max_age_days=0 max_total_bytes=0 keep_latest=0
  local dry_run=1 state_file=""

  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --input) input="${2:?--input requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --now) now="${2:?--now requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-age-days) max_age_days="${2:?--max-age-days requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-total-bytes) max_total_bytes="${2:?--max-total-bytes requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --keep-latest) keep_latest="${2:?--keep-latest requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --state-file) state_file="${2:?--state-file requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --execute) dry_run=0; shift ;;
      --dry-run) dry_run=1; shift ;;
      -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
      *) die "unrecognized argument: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [ -n "$input" ] || die "--input is required"
  [ -n "$now" ] || die "--now is required"
  [ -f "$input" ] || die "input file not found: ${input}"
  [ -n "$state_file" ] || state_file="$input"

  require_number "--max-age-days" "$max_age_days"
  require_number "--max-total-bytes" "$max_total_bytes"
  require_number "--keep-latest" "$keep_latest"

  local now_epoch
  now_epoch="$(to_epoch "$now")"

  read_artifacts "$input"
  [ "${#AC_NAME[@]}" -gt 0 ] || die "no artifacts found in: ${input}"

  apply_keep_latest "$keep_latest"
  apply_max_age "$max_age_days" "$now_epoch"
  apply_max_total_bytes "$max_total_bytes"

  print_plan_and_summary "$(basename "$input")" "$dry_run"

  if [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ]; then
    rewrite_state_file "$state_file"
  fi
}

main "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# Scratch TDD driver used only during development to get fast red/green
# cycles without paying the act container tax. Deleted before final delivery
# once test/artifact-cleanup.bats (the act-routed suite) is in place.

setup() {
  ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/.." && pwd)"
  SCRIPT="${ROOT}/artifact-cleanup.sh"
  TMPD="$(mktemp -d)"
}

teardown() {
  rm -rf "${TMPD}"
}

  run grep -c '^fresh,' "${TMPD}/ex.csv"

  # Second execute run over the now-mutated file finds nothing left to delete.
  run bash "${SCRIPT}" --input "${TMPD}/ex.csv" --now 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z --max-age-days 1 --execute
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"RESULT input=ex.csv total=1 retained=1 deleted=0 reclaimed_bytes=0 retained_bytes=2000000"* ]]
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# artifact-cleanup.sh — apply CI artifact retention policies and produce a
# deletion plan.
#
# Reads a CSV inventory of artifacts (name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,
# run_id), applies up to three retention policies, and reports which
# artifacts would be (or were) deleted:
#
#   --max-age-days N     delete artifacts older than N days
#   --max-total-bytes N  delete oldest-first until total retained size <= N
#   --keep-latest N      per workflow, always protect the N most recent
#                         artifacts; anything beyond that cutoff is deleted
#                         for exceeding the keep-latest cap
#
# keep-latest-protected artifacts are exempt from every other policy. Any
# policy left at 0 is disabled.
#
# Defaults to --dry-run (report only). --execute additionally rewrites the
# input file (or --state-file, if given) to drop deleted rows, simulating a
# real deletion against the artifact store.
set -euo pipefail

readonly PROG="${0##*/}"

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ${PROG} --input FILE --now ISO8601 [options]

Required:
  --input FILE            CSV inventory: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  --now ISO8601           Reference timestamp used for age calculations

Options:
  --max-age-days N        Delete artifacts older than N days (default: disabled)
  --max-total-bytes N     Cap total retained size in bytes (default: disabled)
  --keep-latest N         Always protect the N most recent artifacts per workflow (default: disabled)
  --execute                Actually apply the plan (rewrites --state-file / --input)
  --dry-run                Report only; do not mutate any file (default)
  --state-file FILE        File to rewrite on --execute (default: --input)
  -h, --help                Show this help
EOF
}

die() {
  echo "${PROG}: error: $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

require_number() {
  # require_number LABEL VALUE — die unless VALUE is a non-negative integer.
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "$1 must be a non-negative integer, got: '$2'"
}

to_epoch() {
  # to_epoch ISO8601 — echo Unix seconds, or die with a clear message.
  local epoch
  if ! epoch="$(date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)"; then
    die "invalid date/timestamp: '$1'"
  fi
  echo "$epoch"
}

# Parallel arrays describing every artifact read from the input file, plus
# per-artifact working state computed by the policy passes below.
declare -a AC_NAME AC_SIZE AC_CREATED AC_WORKFLOW AC_RUNID AC_EPOCH
declare -a AC_PROTECTED AC_DELETED AC_REASON

read_artifacts() {
  # read_artifacts FILE — populate the AC_* arrays from a CSV inventory.
  # Format: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  # A header row (first non-comment line) is skipped if present. Blank lines
  # and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
  local file="$1" line lineno=0 header_skipped=0
  local name size created workflow runid

  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    if [ "$header_skipped" -eq 0 ] && [[ "$line" == name,size_bytes,* ]]; then
      header_skipped=1
      continue
    fi
    header_skipped=1

    IFS=',' read -r name size created workflow runid <<<"$line"
    if [ -z "$name" ] || [ -z "$size" ] || [ -z "$created" ] || [ -z "$workflow" ] || [ -z "$runid" ]; then
      die "${file}:${lineno}: expected 5 comma-separated fields, got: '${line}'"
    fi
    [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "${file}:${lineno}: size_bytes must be a non-negative integer, got: '${size}'"

    AC_NAME+=("$name")
    AC_SIZE+=("$size")
    AC_CREATED+=("$created")
    AC_WORKFLOW+=("$workflow")
    AC_RUNID+=("$runid")
    AC_EPOCH+=("$(to_epoch "$created")")
    AC_PROTECTED+=(0)
    AC_DELETED+=(0)
    AC_REASON+=("retained")
  done <"$file"
}

apply_keep_latest() {
  # apply_keep_latest N MAX_AGE_DAYS MAX_TOTAL_BYTES — for each workflow,
  # protect the N most recent artifacts from every other policy. Artifacts
  # beyond that cutoff are:
  #   - deleted immediately (reason=exceeds-keep-latest) when keep-latest is
  #     the ONLY active policy (age and size both disabled) — the natural
  #     "keep only the last N, drop everything else" behavior;
  #   - otherwise left as ordinary candidates for the age/size passes, so
  #     keep-latest acts purely as a protective floor when combined with
  #     other policies.
  # No-op when N==0 (disabled).
  local keep="$1" max_age_days="$2" max_total_bytes="$3"
  [ "$keep" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local delete_excess=0
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && delete_excess=1

  local workflows
  workflows="$(printf '%s\n' "${AC_WORKFLOW[@]}" | sort -u)"

  local wf
  while IFS= read -r wf; do
    [ -z "$wf" ] && continue
    # index:epoch pairs for this workflow, newest first.
    local i ranked rank=0 idx
    ranked=""
    for i in "${!AC_WORKFLOW[@]}"; do
      [ "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" = "$wf" ] && ranked+="${AC_EPOCH[$i]} ${i}"$'\n'
    done
    while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
      [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
      rank=$((rank + 1))
      if [ "$rank" -le "$keep" ]; then
        AC_PROTECTED[idx]=1
      elif [ "$delete_excess" -eq 1 ]; then
        AC_DELETED[idx]=1
        AC_REASON[idx]="exceeds-keep-latest"
      fi
    done < <(printf '%s' "$ranked" | sort -rn -k1,1)
  done <<<"$workflows"
}

apply_max_age() {
  # apply_max_age DAYS NOW_EPOCH — mark unprotected, not-yet-deleted
  # artifacts older than DAYS as deleted (reason=age). No-op when DAYS==0.
  local max_age_days="$1" now_epoch="$2"
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i age_days
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    age_days=$(( (now_epoch - AC_EPOCH[i]) / 86400 ))
    if [ "$age_days" -gt "$max_age_days" ]; then
      AC_DELETED[i]=1
      AC_REASON[i]="age"
    fi
  done
}

apply_max_total_bytes() {
  # apply_max_total_bytes MAX — delete oldest-first among unprotected,
  # not-yet-deleted artifacts until the retained total fits under MAX.
  # No-op when MAX==0 (disabled).
  local max_total_bytes="$1"
  [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i total=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    total=$((total + AC_SIZE[i]))
  done
  [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && return 0

  local candidates i2 idx
  candidates=""
  for i2 in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    candidates+="${AC_EPOCH[$i2]} ${i2}"$'\n'
  done

  while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
    [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
    [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && break
    AC_DELETED[idx]=1
    AC_REASON[idx]="max-total-size"
    total=$((total - AC_SIZE[idx]))
  done < <(printf '%s' "$candidates" | sort -n -k1,1)
}

print_plan_and_summary() {
  # print_plan_and_summary INPUT_BASENAME DRY_RUN — emit the human-readable
  # plan plus a single machine-parseable RESULT line.
  local input_base="$1" dry_run="$2"
  local mode_label="DRY RUN"
  [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && mode_label="EXECUTE"

  echo "Artifact Cleanup Plan (${mode_label}) for ${input_base}"
  echo ""

  local i verb reclaimed=0 retained_bytes=0 deleted_count=0 retained_count=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    if [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ]; then
      verb="DELETE"
      [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && verb="DELETED"
      reclaimed=$((reclaimed + AC_SIZE[i]))
      deleted_count=$((deleted_count + 1))
    else
      verb="RETAIN"
      retained_bytes=$((retained_bytes + AC_SIZE[i]))
      retained_count=$((retained_count + 1))
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\tworkflow=%s\tsize_bytes=%s\tcreated=%s\treason=%s\n' \
      "$verb" "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_REASON[$i]}"
  done

  echo ""
  echo "Summary:"
  echo "  Total artifacts: ${#AC_NAME[@]}"
  echo "  Retained:        ${retained_count} (${retained_bytes} bytes)"
  echo "  Deleted:         ${deleted_count} (${reclaimed} bytes)"
  echo "  Space reclaimed: ${reclaimed} bytes"
  echo ""
  echo "RESULT input=${input_base} total=${#AC_NAME[@]} retained=${retained_count} deleted=${deleted_count} reclaimed_bytes=${reclaimed} retained_bytes=${retained_bytes}"
}

rewrite_state_file() {
  # rewrite_state_file FILE — drop deleted rows from FILE, keeping the
  # header and any retained rows, in their original order. Used by
  # --execute to simulate the artifact actually being removed from storage.
  local file="$1" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  echo "name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id" >"$tmp"
  local i
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    printf '%s,%s,%s,%s,%s\n' "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_RUNID[$i]}" >>"$tmp"
  done
  mv "$tmp" "$file"
}

main() {
  local input="" now="" max_age_days=0 max_total_bytes=0 keep_latest=0
  local dry_run=1 state_file=""

  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --input) input="${2:?--input requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --now) now="${2:?--now requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-age-days) max_age_days="${2:?--max-age-days requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-total-bytes) max_total_bytes="${2:?--max-total-bytes requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --keep-latest) keep_latest="${2:?--keep-latest requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --state-file) state_file="${2:?--state-file requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --execute) dry_run=0; shift ;;
      --dry-run) dry_run=1; shift ;;
      -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
      *) die "unrecognized argument: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [ -n "$input" ] || die "--input is required"
  [ -n "$now" ] || die "--now is required"
  [ -f "$input" ] || die "input file not found: ${input}"
  [ -n "$state_file" ] || state_file="$input"

  require_number "--max-age-days" "$max_age_days"
  require_number "--max-total-bytes" "$max_total_bytes"
  require_number "--keep-latest" "$keep_latest"

  local now_epoch
  now_epoch="$(to_epoch "$now")"

  read_artifacts "$input"
  [ "${#AC_NAME[@]}" -gt 0 ] || die "no artifacts found in: ${input}"

  apply_keep_latest "$keep_latest" "$max_age_days" "$max_total_bytes"
  apply_max_age "$max_age_days" "$now_epoch"
  apply_max_total_bytes "$max_total_bytes"

  print_plan_and_summary "$(basename "$input")" "$dry_run"

  if [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ]; then
    rewrite_state_file "$state_file"
  fi
}

main "$@"

283	  apply_max_age "$max_age_days" "$now_epoch"
284	  apply_max_total_bytes "$max_total_bytes"
285	
286	  print_plan_and_summary "$(basename "$input")" "$dry_run"
287	
288	  if [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ]; then
289	    rewrite_state_file "$state_file"
290	  fi
291	}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# artifact-cleanup.sh — apply CI artifact retention policies and produce a
# deletion plan.
#
# Reads a CSV inventory of artifacts (name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,
# run_id), applies up to three retention policies, and reports which
# artifacts would be (or were) deleted:
#
#   --max-age-days N     delete artifacts older than N days
#   --max-total-bytes N  delete oldest-first until total retained size <= N
#   --keep-latest N      per workflow, always protect the N most recent
#                         artifacts; anything beyond that cutoff is deleted
#                         for exceeding the keep-latest cap
#
# keep-latest-protected artifacts are exempt from every other policy. Any
# policy left at 0 is disabled.
#
# Defaults to --dry-run (report only). --execute additionally rewrites the
# input file (or --state-file, if given) to drop deleted rows, simulating a
# real deletion against the artifact store.
set -euo pipefail

readonly PROG="${0##*/}"

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ${PROG} --input FILE --now ISO8601 [options]

Required:
  --input FILE            CSV inventory: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  --now ISO8601           Reference timestamp used for age calculations

Options:
  --max-age-days N        Delete artifacts older than N days (default: disabled)
  --max-total-bytes N     Cap total retained size in bytes (default: disabled)
  --keep-latest N         Always protect the N most recent artifacts per workflow (default: disabled)
  --execute                Actually apply the plan (rewrites --state-file / --input)
  --dry-run                Report only; do not mutate any file (default)
  --state-file FILE        File to rewrite on --execute (default: --input)
  -h, --help                Show this help
EOF
}

die() {
  echo "${PROG}: error: $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

require_number() {
  # require_number LABEL VALUE — die unless VALUE is a non-negative integer.
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "$1 must be a non-negative integer, got: '$2'"
}

to_epoch() {
  # to_epoch ISO8601 — echo Unix seconds, or die with a clear message.
  local epoch
  if ! epoch="$(date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)"; then
    die "invalid date/timestamp: '$1'"
  fi
  echo "$epoch"
}

# Parallel arrays describing every artifact read from the input file, plus
# per-artifact working state computed by the policy passes below.
declare -a AC_NAME=() AC_SIZE=() AC_CREATED=() AC_WORKFLOW=() AC_RUNID=() AC_EPOCH=()
declare -a AC_PROTECTED=() AC_DELETED=() AC_REASON=()

read_artifacts() {
  # read_artifacts FILE — populate the AC_* arrays from a CSV inventory.
  # Format: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  # A header row (first non-comment line) is skipped if present. Blank lines
  # and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
  local file="$1" line lineno=0 header_skipped=0
  local name size created workflow runid

  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    if [ "$header_skipped" -eq 0 ] && [[ "$line" == name,size_bytes,* ]]; then
      header_skipped=1
      continue
    fi
    header_skipped=1

    IFS=',' read -r name size created workflow runid <<<"$line"
    if [ -z "$name" ] || [ -z "$size" ] || [ -z "$created" ] || [ -z "$workflow" ] || [ -z "$runid" ]; then
      die "${file}:${lineno}: expected 5 comma-separated fields, got: '${line}'"
    fi
    [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "${file}:${lineno}: size_bytes must be a non-negative integer, got: '${size}'"

    AC_NAME+=("$name")
    AC_SIZE+=("$size")
    AC_CREATED+=("$created")
    AC_WORKFLOW+=("$workflow")
    AC_RUNID+=("$runid")
    AC_EPOCH+=("$(to_epoch "$created")")
    AC_PROTECTED+=(0)
    AC_DELETED+=(0)
    AC_REASON+=("retained")
  done <"$file"
}

apply_keep_latest() {
  # apply_keep_latest N MAX_AGE_DAYS MAX_TOTAL_BYTES — for each workflow,
  # protect the N most recent artifacts from every other policy. Artifacts
  # beyond that cutoff are:
  #   - deleted immediately (reason=exceeds-keep-latest) when keep-latest is
  #     the ONLY active policy (age and size both disabled) — the natural
  #     "keep only the last N, drop everything else" behavior;
  #   - otherwise left as ordinary candidates for the age/size passes, so
  #     keep-latest acts purely as a protective floor when combined with
  #     other policies.
  # No-op when N==0 (disabled).
  local keep="$1" max_age_days="$2" max_total_bytes="$3"
  [ "$keep" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local delete_excess=0
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && delete_excess=1

  local workflows
  workflows="$(printf '%s\n' "${AC_WORKFLOW[@]}" | sort -u)"

  local wf
  while IFS= read -r wf; do
    [ -z "$wf" ] && continue
    # index:epoch pairs for this workflow, newest first.
    local i ranked rank=0 idx
    ranked=""
    for i in "${!AC_WORKFLOW[@]}"; do
      [ "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" = "$wf" ] && ranked+="${AC_EPOCH[$i]} ${i}"$'\n'
    done
    while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
      [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
      rank=$((rank + 1))
      if [ "$rank" -le "$keep" ]; then
        AC_PROTECTED[idx]=1
      elif [ "$delete_excess" -eq 1 ]; then
        AC_DELETED[idx]=1
        AC_REASON[idx]="exceeds-keep-latest"
      fi
    done < <(printf '%s' "$ranked" | sort -rn -k1,1)
  done <<<"$workflows"
}

apply_max_age() {
  # apply_max_age DAYS NOW_EPOCH — mark unprotected, not-yet-deleted
  # artifacts older than DAYS as deleted (reason=age). No-op when DAYS==0.
  local max_age_days="$1" now_epoch="$2"
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i age_days
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    age_days=$(( (now_epoch - AC_EPOCH[i]) / 86400 ))
    if [ "$age_days" -gt "$max_age_days" ]; then
      AC_DELETED[i]=1
      AC_REASON[i]="age"
    fi
  done
}

apply_max_total_bytes() {
  # apply_max_total_bytes MAX — delete oldest-first among unprotected,
  # not-yet-deleted artifacts until the retained total fits under MAX.
  # No-op when MAX==0 (disabled).
  local max_total_bytes="$1"
  [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i total=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    total=$((total + AC_SIZE[i]))
  done
  [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && return 0

  local candidates i2 idx
  candidates=""
  for i2 in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    candidates+="${AC_EPOCH[$i2]} ${i2}"$'\n'
  done

  while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
    [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
    [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && break
    AC_DELETED[idx]=1
    AC_REASON[idx]="max-total-size"
    total=$((total - AC_SIZE[idx]))
  done < <(printf '%s' "$candidates" | sort -n -k1,1)
}

print_plan_and_summary() {
  # print_plan_and_summary INPUT_BASENAME DRY_RUN — emit the human-readable
  # plan plus a single machine-parseable RESULT line.
  local input_base="$1" dry_run="$2"
  local mode_label="DRY RUN"
  [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && mode_label="EXECUTE"

  echo "Artifact Cleanup Plan (${mode_label}) for ${input_base}"
  echo ""

  local i verb reclaimed=0 retained_bytes=0 deleted_count=0 retained_count=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    if [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ]; then
      verb="DELETE"
      [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && verb="DELETED"
      reclaimed=$((reclaimed + AC_SIZE[i]))
      deleted_count=$((deleted_count + 1))
    else
      verb="RETAIN"
      retained_bytes=$((retained_bytes + AC_SIZE[i]))
      retained_count=$((retained_count + 1))
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\tworkflow=%s\tsize_bytes=%s\tcreated=%s\treason=%s\n' \
      "$verb" "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_REASON[$i]}"
  done

  echo ""
  echo "Summary:"
  echo "  Total artifacts: ${#AC_NAME[@]}"
  echo "  Retained:        ${retained_count} (${retained_bytes} bytes)"
  echo "  Deleted:         ${deleted_count} (${reclaimed} bytes)"
  echo "  Space reclaimed: ${reclaimed} bytes"
  echo ""
  echo "RESULT input=${input_base} total=${#AC_NAME[@]} retained=${retained_count} deleted=${deleted_count} reclaimed_bytes=${reclaimed} retained_bytes=${retained_bytes}"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# artifact-cleanup.sh — apply CI artifact retention policies and produce a
# deletion plan.
#
# Reads a CSV inventory of artifacts (name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,
# run_id), applies up to three retention policies, and reports which
# artifacts would be (or were) deleted:
#
#   --max-age-days N     delete artifacts older than N days
#   --max-total-bytes N  delete oldest-first until total retained size <= N
#   --keep-latest N      per workflow, always protect the N most recent
#                         artifacts; anything beyond that cutoff is deleted
#                         for exceeding the keep-latest cap
#
# keep-latest-protected artifacts are exempt from every other policy. Any
# policy left at 0 is disabled.
#
# Defaults to --dry-run (report only). --execute additionally rewrites the
# input file (or --state-file, if given) to drop deleted rows, simulating a
# real deletion against the artifact store.
set -euo pipefail

readonly PROG="${0##*/}"

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: ${PROG} --input FILE --now ISO8601 [options]

Required:
  --input FILE            CSV inventory: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  --now ISO8601           Reference timestamp used for age calculations

Options:
  --max-age-days N        Delete artifacts older than N days (default: disabled)
  --max-total-bytes N     Cap total retained size in bytes (default: disabled)
  --keep-latest N         Always protect the N most recent artifacts per workflow (default: disabled)
  --execute                Actually apply the plan (rewrites --state-file / --input)
  --dry-run                Report only; do not mutate any file (default)
  --state-file FILE        File to rewrite on --execute (default: --input)
  -h, --help                Show this help
EOF
}

die() {
  echo "${PROG}: error: $*" >&2
  exit 2
}

require_number() {
  # require_number LABEL VALUE — die unless VALUE is a non-negative integer.
  [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "$1 must be a non-negative integer, got: '$2'"
}

to_epoch() {
  # to_epoch ISO8601 — echo Unix seconds, or die with a clear message.
  local epoch
  if ! epoch="$(date -u -d "$1" +%s 2>/dev/null)"; then
    die "invalid date/timestamp: '$1'"
  fi
  echo "$epoch"
}

# Parallel arrays describing every artifact read from the input file, plus
# per-artifact working state computed by the policy passes below.
declare -a AC_NAME=() AC_SIZE=() AC_CREATED=() AC_WORKFLOW=() AC_RUNID=() AC_EPOCH=()
declare -a AC_PROTECTED=() AC_DELETED=() AC_REASON=()

read_artifacts() {
  # read_artifacts FILE — populate the AC_* arrays from a CSV inventory.
  # Format: name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id
  # A header row (first non-comment line) is skipped if present. Blank lines
  # and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
  local file="$1" line lineno=0 header_skipped=0
  local name size created workflow runid

  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    [ -z "$line" ] && continue
    [[ "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    if [ "$header_skipped" -eq 0 ] && [[ "$line" == name,size_bytes,* ]]; then
      header_skipped=1
      continue
    fi
    header_skipped=1

    IFS=',' read -r name size created workflow runid <<<"$line"
    if [ -z "$name" ] || [ -z "$size" ] || [ -z "$created" ] || [ -z "$workflow" ] || [ -z "$runid" ]; then
      die "${file}:${lineno}: expected 5 comma-separated fields, got: '${line}'"
    fi
    [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "${file}:${lineno}: size_bytes must be a non-negative integer, got: '${size}'"

    AC_NAME+=("$name")
    AC_SIZE+=("$size")
    AC_CREATED+=("$created")
    AC_WORKFLOW+=("$workflow")
    AC_RUNID+=("$runid")
    AC_EPOCH+=("$(to_epoch "$created")")
    AC_PROTECTED+=(0)
    AC_DELETED+=(0)
    AC_REASON+=("retained")
  done <"$file"
}

apply_keep_latest() {
  # apply_keep_latest N MAX_AGE_DAYS MAX_TOTAL_BYTES — for each workflow,
  # protect the N most recent artifacts from every other policy. Artifacts
  # beyond that cutoff are:
  #   - deleted immediately (reason=exceeds-keep-latest) when keep-latest is
  #     the ONLY active policy (age and size both disabled) — the natural
  #     "keep only the last N, drop everything else" behavior;
  #   - otherwise left as ordinary candidates for the age/size passes, so
  #     keep-latest acts purely as a protective floor when combined with
  #     other policies.
  # No-op when N==0 (disabled).
  local keep="$1" max_age_days="$2" max_total_bytes="$3"
  [ "$keep" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local delete_excess=0
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && delete_excess=1

  local workflows
  workflows="$(printf '%s\n' "${AC_WORKFLOW[@]}" | sort -u)"

  local wf
  while IFS= read -r wf; do
    [ -z "$wf" ] && continue
    # index:epoch pairs for this workflow, newest first.
    local i ranked rank=0 idx
    ranked=""
    for i in "${!AC_WORKFLOW[@]}"; do
      [ "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" = "$wf" ] && ranked+="${AC_EPOCH[$i]} ${i}"$'\n'
    done
    while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
      [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
      rank=$((rank + 1))
      if [ "$rank" -le "$keep" ]; then
        AC_PROTECTED[idx]=1
      elif [ "$delete_excess" -eq 1 ]; then
        AC_DELETED[idx]=1
        AC_REASON[idx]="exceeds-keep-latest"
      fi
    done < <(printf '%s' "$ranked" | sort -rn -k1,1)
  done <<<"$workflows"
}

apply_max_age() {
  # apply_max_age DAYS NOW_EPOCH — mark unprotected, not-yet-deleted
  # artifacts older than DAYS as deleted (reason=age). No-op when DAYS==0.
  local max_age_days="$1" now_epoch="$2"
  [ "$max_age_days" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i age_days
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    age_days=$(( (now_epoch - AC_EPOCH[i]) / 86400 ))
    if [ "$age_days" -gt "$max_age_days" ]; then
      AC_DELETED[i]=1
      AC_REASON[i]="age"
    fi
  done
}

apply_max_total_bytes() {
  # apply_max_total_bytes MAX — delete oldest-first among unprotected,
  # not-yet-deleted artifacts until the retained total fits under MAX.
  # No-op when MAX==0 (disabled).
  local max_total_bytes="$1"
  [ "$max_total_bytes" -eq 0 ] && return 0

  local i total=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    total=$((total + AC_SIZE[i]))
  done
  [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && return 0

  local candidates i2 idx
  candidates=""
  for i2 in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_PROTECTED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i2]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    candidates+="${AC_EPOCH[$i2]} ${i2}"$'\n'
  done

  while IFS=' ' read -r _ idx; do
    [ -z "$idx" ] && continue
    [ "$total" -le "$max_total_bytes" ] && break
    AC_DELETED[idx]=1
    AC_REASON[idx]="max-total-size"
    total=$((total - AC_SIZE[idx]))
  done < <(printf '%s' "$candidates" | sort -n -k1,1)
}

print_plan_and_summary() {
  # print_plan_and_summary INPUT_BASENAME DRY_RUN — emit the human-readable
  # plan plus a single machine-parseable RESULT line.
  local input_base="$1" dry_run="$2"
  local mode_label="DRY RUN"
  [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && mode_label="EXECUTE"

  echo "Artifact Cleanup Plan (${mode_label}) for ${input_base}"
  echo ""

  local i verb reclaimed=0 retained_bytes=0 deleted_count=0 retained_count=0
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    if [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ]; then
      verb="DELETE"
      [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ] && verb="DELETED"
      reclaimed=$((reclaimed + AC_SIZE[i]))
      deleted_count=$((deleted_count + 1))
    else
      verb="RETAIN"
      retained_bytes=$((retained_bytes + AC_SIZE[i]))
      retained_count=$((retained_count + 1))
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\tworkflow=%s\tsize_bytes=%s\tcreated=%s\treason=%s\n' \
      "$verb" "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_REASON[$i]}"
  done

  echo ""
  echo "Summary:"
  echo "  Total artifacts: ${#AC_NAME[@]}"
  echo "  Retained:        ${retained_count} (${retained_bytes} bytes)"
  echo "  Deleted:         ${deleted_count} (${reclaimed} bytes)"
  echo "  Space reclaimed: ${reclaimed} bytes"
  echo ""
  echo "RESULT input=${input_base} total=${#AC_NAME[@]} retained=${retained_count} deleted=${deleted_count} reclaimed_bytes=${reclaimed} retained_bytes=${retained_bytes}"
}

rewrite_state_file() {
  # rewrite_state_file FILE — drop deleted rows from FILE, keeping the
  # header and any retained rows, in their original order. Used by
  # --execute to simulate the artifact actually being removed from storage.
  local file="$1" tmp
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  echo "name,size_bytes,created_date,workflow,run_id" >"$tmp"
  local i
  for i in "${!AC_NAME[@]}"; do
    [ "${AC_DELETED[$i]}" -eq 1 ] && continue
    printf '%s,%s,%s,%s,%s\n' "${AC_NAME[$i]}" "${AC_SIZE[$i]}" "${AC_CREATED[$i]}" "${AC_WORKFLOW[$i]}" "${AC_RUNID[$i]}" >>"$tmp"
  done
  mv "$tmp" "$file"
}

main() {
  local input="" now="" max_age_days=0 max_total_bytes=0 keep_latest=0
  local dry_run=1 state_file=""

  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
      --input) input="${2:?--input requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --now) now="${2:?--now requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-age-days) max_age_days="${2:?--max-age-days requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --max-total-bytes) max_total_bytes="${2:?--max-total-bytes requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --keep-latest) keep_latest="${2:?--keep-latest requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --state-file) state_file="${2:?--state-file requires a value}"; shift 2 ;;
      --execute) dry_run=0; shift ;;
      --dry-run) dry_run=1; shift ;;
      -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
      *) die "unrecognized argument: $1" ;;
    esac
  done

  [ -n "$input" ] || die "--input is required"
  [ -n "$now" ] || die "--now is required"
  [ -f "$input" ] || die "input file not found: ${input}"
  [ -n "$state_file" ] || state_file="$input"

  require_number "--max-age-days" "$max_age_days"
  require_number "--max-total-bytes" "$max_total_bytes"
  require_number "--keep-latest" "$keep_latest"

  local now_epoch
  now_epoch="$(to_epoch "$now")"

  read_artifacts "$input"
  [ "${#AC_NAME[@]}" -gt 0 ] || die "no artifacts found in: ${input}"

  apply_keep_latest "$keep_latest" "$max_age_days" "$max_total_bytes"
  apply_max_age "$max_age_days" "$now_epoch"
  apply_max_total_bytes "$max_total_bytes"

  print_plan_and_summary "$(basename "$input")" "$dry_run"

  if [ "$dry_run" -eq 0 ]; then

}

main "$@"

---
# Artifact Cleanup Script pipeline (Task 17).
#
# Runs artifact-cleanup.sh's retention-policy engine against every fixture
# under fixtures/ inside the container and self-checks each case's exact
# known-good result. This is the kind of scheduled maintenance job that
# would prune stale CI artifacts in a real repo; here it runs entirely on
# committed mock CSV data so it is hermetic (no external services, no
# secrets, no GitHub API calls).
#
# Two jobs, chained with `needs`:
#   cleanup -> report
# `cleanup` processes every fixture case in a single job run and exposes the
# aggregate totals as job outputs. `report` consumes those outputs and
# publishes/validates the final aggregate line.
name: Artifact Cleanup Script

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    # Nightly, matching a realistic artifact-retention maintenance cadence.
    - cron: '17 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Reference "now" pinned for deterministic, reproducible age calculations.
  REFERENCE_NOW: '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'
  FIXTURES_DIR: fixtures

jobs:
  cleanup:
    name: Compute deletion plans
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      total_cases: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_cases }}
      total_artifacts: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_artifacts }}
      total_retained: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_retained }}
      total_deleted: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_deleted }}
      total_reclaimed_bytes: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_reclaimed_bytes }}
      total_retained_bytes: ${{ steps.run_cases.outputs.total_retained_bytes }}
      dryrun_execute_ok: ${{ steps.dryrun_execute.outputs.dryrun_execute_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify runtime dependencies
        # artifact-cleanup.sh only needs bash + coreutils, all present on
        # ubuntu-latest. Verify rather than install.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for tool in bash date sort basename mktemp; do
            command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "missing required tool: $tool" >&2; exit 1; }
          done
          echo "All required tools present."

      - name: Syntax-check the cleanup script
        run: bash -n artifact-cleanup.sh

      - name: Lint the cleanup script with shellcheck
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            shellcheck artifact-cleanup.sh
            echo "shellcheck: clean"
          else
            echo "shellcheck not installed; skipping lint"
          fi

      - name: Run every fixture case and assert exact expected results
        id: run_cases
        env:
          REFERENCE_NOW: ${{ env.REFERENCE_NOW }}
          FIXTURES_DIR: ${{ env.FIXTURES_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Hand-computed known-good results per fixture (see each fixture's
          # header comment for the derivation). The job FAILS if the engine
          # regresses, so a green "Job succeeded" is a real correctness signal.
          declare -A policy=(
            [case1-max-age]="--max-age-days 14"
            [case2-keep-latest]="--keep-latest 2"
            [case3-max-total-bytes]="--max-total-bytes 10000000"
            [case4-combined]="--max-age-days 20 --keep-latest 1 --max-total-bytes 5000000"
            [case5-all-retained]="--max-age-days 365 --keep-latest 5 --max-total-bytes 100000000"
          )
          declare -A exp_total=(   [case1-max-age]=4 [case2-keep-latest]=8 [case3-max-total-bytes]=3 [case4-combined]=4 [case5-all-retained]=2 )
          declare -A exp_retained=([case1-max-age]=2 [case2-keep-latest]=4 [case3-max-total-bytes]=2 [case4-combined]=1 [case5-all-retained]=2 )
          declare -A exp_deleted=( [case1-max-age]=2 [case2-keep-latest]=4 [case3-max-total-bytes]=1 [case4-combined]=3 [case5-all-retained]=0 )
          declare -A exp_reclaimed=([case1-max-age]=5000000 [case2-keep-latest]=7000000 [case3-max-total-bytes]=6000000 [case4-combined]=7000000 [case5-all-retained]=0)
          declare -A exp_retained_bytes=([case1-max-age]=1500000 [case2-keep-latest]=10000000 [case3-max-total-bytes]=9000000 [case4-combined]=3000000 [case5-all-retained]=3000000)

          # Extract a "key=value" token from the script's RESULT line.
          field() {
            awk -v key="$1" 'BEGIN { FS = "[ =]" }
              { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == key) { print $(i + 1); exit } }'
          }

          {
            echo "## Artifact Cleanup Plan"
            echo ""
            echo "| case | total | retained | deleted | reclaimed_bytes |"
            echo "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"
          } >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

          total_cases=0 total_artifacts=0 total_retained=0 total_deleted=0 total_reclaimed=0 total_retained_bytes=0

          for name in case1-max-age case2-keep-latest case3-max-total-bytes case4-combined case5-all-retained; do
            fixture="${FIXTURES_DIR}/${name}.csv"
            echo "===== CASE: ${name} ====="
            # shellcheck disable=SC2086
            out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$fixture" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" ${policy[$name]})"
            printf '%s\n' "$out"

            result_line="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep '^RESULT ')"
            got_total="$(printf '%s' "$result_line" | field total)"
            got_retained="$(printf '%s' "$result_line" | field retained)"
            got_deleted="$(printf '%s' "$result_line" | field deleted)"
            got_reclaimed="$(printf '%s' "$result_line" | field reclaimed_bytes)"
            got_retained_bytes="$(printf '%s' "$result_line" | field retained_bytes)"

            if [ "$got_total" != "${exp_total[$name]}" ] || \
               [ "$got_retained" != "${exp_retained[$name]}" ] || \
               [ "$got_deleted" != "${exp_deleted[$name]}" ] || \
               [ "$got_reclaimed" != "${exp_reclaimed[$name]}" ] || \
               [ "$got_retained_bytes" != "${exp_retained_bytes[$name]}" ]; then
              echo "ASSERTION FAILED for ${name}: got total=${got_total} retained=${got_retained} deleted=${got_deleted}" \
                   "reclaimed_bytes=${got_reclaimed} retained_bytes=${got_retained_bytes}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "OK: ${name} matches expected (total=${got_total} retained=${got_retained} deleted=${got_deleted} reclaimed_bytes=${got_reclaimed})"
            echo "| ${name} | ${got_total} | ${got_retained} | ${got_deleted} | ${got_reclaimed} |" >>"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

            total_cases=$((total_cases + 1))
            total_artifacts=$((total_artifacts + got_total))
            total_retained=$((total_retained + got_retained))
            total_deleted=$((total_deleted + got_deleted))
            total_reclaimed=$((total_reclaimed + got_reclaimed))
            total_retained_bytes=$((total_retained_bytes + got_retained_bytes))
          done

          echo "AGGREGATE total_cases=${total_cases} total_artifacts=${total_artifacts} total_retained=${total_retained} total_deleted=${total_deleted} total_reclaimed_bytes=${total_reclaimed} total_retained_bytes=${total_retained_bytes}"

          {
            echo "total_cases=${total_cases}"
            echo "total_artifacts=${total_artifacts}"
            echo "total_retained=${total_retained}"
            echo "total_deleted=${total_deleted}"
            echo "total_reclaimed_bytes=${total_reclaimed}"
            echo "total_retained_bytes=${total_retained_bytes}"
          } >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify dry-run vs execute semantics (case6)
        id: dryrun_execute
        env:
          REFERENCE_NOW: ${{ env.REFERENCE_NOW }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          work="$(mktemp -d)/case6.csv"
          cp "fixtures/case6-dry-run-vs-execute.csv" "$work"
          before_hash="$(sha256sum "$work" | awk '{print $1}')"

          dryrun_out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$work" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" --max-age-days 1)"
          printf '%s\n' "$dryrun_out"
          after_hash="$(sha256sum "$work" | awk '{print $1}')"
          if [ "$before_hash" != "$after_hash" ]; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: dry-run mutated the input file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! printf '%s' "$dryrun_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=2 retained=1 deleted=1 reclaimed_bytes=1000000 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: unexpected dry-run RESULT line" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          exec_out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$work" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" --max-age-days 1 --execute)"
          printf '%s\n' "$exec_out"
          if ! printf '%s' "$exec_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=2 retained=1 deleted=1 reclaimed_bytes=1000000 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: unexpected execute RESULT line" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -q '^old,' "$work"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: execute did not remove the deleted row from the state file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -q '^fresh,' "$work"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: execute removed a row that should have been retained" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          second_out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$work" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" --max-age-days 1 --execute)"
          printf '%s\n' "$second_out"
          if ! printf '%s' "$second_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=1 retained=1 deleted=0 reclaimed_bytes=0 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: second execute run was not idempotent" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "OK: dry-run left the file untouched; execute mutated it and was idempotent on rerun."
          echo "dryrun_execute_ok=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  report:
    name: Publish final report
    needs: cleanup
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TOTAL_CASES: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_cases }}
      TOTAL_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_artifacts }}
      TOTAL_RETAINED: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_retained }}
      TOTAL_DELETED: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_deleted }}
      TOTAL_RECLAIMED_BYTES: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_reclaimed_bytes }}
      TOTAL_RETAINED_BYTES: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_retained_bytes }}
      DRYRUN_EXECUTE_OK: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.dryrun_execute_ok }}
    steps:
      - name: Emit and validate aggregate report
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          echo "FINAL_REPORT total_cases=${TOTAL_CASES} total_artifacts=${TOTAL_ARTIFACTS} total_retained=${TOTAL_RETAINED} total_deleted=${TOTAL_DELETED} total_reclaimed_bytes=${TOTAL_RECLAIMED_BYTES} total_retained_bytes=${TOTAL_RETAINED_BYTES}"

          exp_cases=5
          exp_artifacts=21
          exp_retained=11
          exp_deleted=10
          exp_reclaimed=25000000
          exp_retained_bytes=26500000

          if [ "$TOTAL_CASES" != "$exp_cases" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_ARTIFACTS" != "$exp_artifacts" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_RETAINED" != "$exp_retained" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_DELETED" != "$exp_deleted" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_RECLAIMED_BYTES" != "$exp_reclaimed" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_RETAINED_BYTES" != "$exp_retained_bytes" ]; then
            echo "AGGREGATE ASSERTION FAILED" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$DRYRUN_EXECUTE_OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: dry-run/execute check did not report ok" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Aggregate totals match known-good values; dry-run/execute semantics verified."

               [ "$got_retained_bytes" != "${exp_retained_bytes[$name]}" ]; then

                   "reclaimed_bytes=${got_reclaimed} retained_bytes=${got_retained_bytes}" >&2

            total_artifacts=$((total_artifacts + got_total))
            total_retained=$((total_retained + got_retained))
            total_deleted=$((total_deleted + got_deleted))
            total_reclaimed=$((total_reclaimed + got_reclaimed))
            total_retained_bytes=$((total_retained_bytes + got_retained_bytes))

            echo "total_artifacts=${total_artifacts}"
            echo "total_retained=${total_retained}"
            echo "total_deleted=${total_deleted}"
            echo "total_reclaimed_bytes=${total_reclaimed}"
            echo "total_retained_bytes=${total_retained_bytes}"
          } >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        id: dryrun_execute
        env:
          REFERENCE_NOW: ${{ env.REFERENCE_NOW }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          work="$(mktemp -d)/case6.csv"
          cp "fixtures/case6-dry-run-vs-execute.csv" "$work"
          before_hash="$(sha256sum "$work" | awk '{print $1}')"

          printf '%s\n' "$dryrun_out"
          after_hash="$(sha256sum "$work" | awk '{print $1}')"
          if [ "$before_hash" != "$after_hash" ]; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: dry-run mutated the input file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! printf '%s' "$dryrun_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=2 retained=1 deleted=1 reclaimed_bytes=1000000 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: unexpected dry-run RESULT line" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          exec_out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$work" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" --max-age-days 1 --execute)"
          printf '%s\n' "$exec_out"
          if ! printf '%s' "$exec_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=2 retained=1 deleted=1 reclaimed_bytes=1000000 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: unexpected execute RESULT line" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if grep -q '^old,' "$work"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: execute did not remove the deleted row from the state file" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! grep -q '^fresh,' "$work"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: execute removed a row that should have been retained" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          second_out="$(bash ./artifact-cleanup.sh --input "$work" --now "$REFERENCE_NOW" --max-age-days 1 --execute)"
          printf '%s\n' "$second_out"
          if ! printf '%s' "$second_out" | grep -qF "RESULT input=case6.csv total=1 retained=1 deleted=0 reclaimed_bytes=0 retained_bytes=2000000"; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: second execute run was not idempotent" >&2
            exit 1

          echo "dryrun_execute_ok=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      TOTAL_RETAINED_BYTES: ${{ needs.cleanup.outputs.total_retained_bytes }}

    steps:

          set -euo pipefail

          exp_cases=5
          exp_artifacts=21
          exp_retained=11
          exp_deleted=10
          exp_reclaimed=25000000
          exp_retained_bytes=26500000

          if [ "$TOTAL_CASES" != "$exp_cases" ] || \

             [ "$TOTAL_RETAINED" != "$exp_retained" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_DELETED" != "$exp_deleted" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_RECLAIMED_BYTES" != "$exp_reclaimed" ] || \
             [ "$TOTAL_RETAINED_BYTES" != "$exp_retained_bytes" ]; then
            echo "AGGREGATE ASSERTION FAILED" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$DRYRUN_EXECUTE_OK" != "true" ]; then
            echo "ASSERTION FAILED: dry-run/execute check did not report ok" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
